_about: Trampoline skills, named from what a flight did: the position it left from and landed in, signed quarter turns of flip (positive is backward), half turns of twist, and the shape held most. The first row that matches names the flight; `value` is its difficulty in points before the landing's grade. A row with value 0 is a move between positions, not a trick, and does not break a routine. `pose` is tuck, pike, straight or any. `min_cm` is centimetres the centre of mass must rise above the takeoff. Names are real trampoline vocabulary: a barani is a front flip with a half twist, a rudy a front flip with one and a half, a randy two and a half; swivel hips is seat drop, half twist, seat drop; a cradle is back drop, half twist, back drop.
_judgements: Slushline's thresholds (data/judgements.json there, lowered at Sam's request on 2026-10-05) and its flair: 30 in a hundred judged landings say the hip word instead. A crash is oh_no, or darn as its flair; both are Sam's own recordings from Slushline.
roof_how: Any trick can land on the truck's roof: hold the up arrow while the bed throws you up, to travel toward the truck.

tricks.name: To feet
tricks.how: The bed throws you back to your feet after a drop. Nothing to press.

tricks.name: To feet
tricks.how: The bed throws you back to your feet after a drop. Nothing to press.

tricks.name: To feet
tricks.how: The bed throws you back to your feet after a drop. Nothing to press.

tricks.name: Seat drop
tricks.how: Land sitting, legs straight out in front. Bounce, then hold K (pike) as you come down; the bed throws you back up to your feet.

tricks.name: Seat drop
tricks.how: Land sitting, legs straight out in front. Bounce, then hold K (pike) as you come down; the bed throws you back up to your feet.

tricks.name: Half twist to seat
tricks.how: Hold A or D through the push for a half turn, then K as you come down to land sitting.

tricks.name: Swivel hips
tricks.how: Seat drop, half twist in the air, seat drop again. From a seat drop, hold A or D as the bed throws you up.

tricks.name: Back drop
tricks.how: Land flat on your back. Tap S briefly during the push, a quarter turn backward, and stay straight.

tricks.name: Cradle
tricks.how: Back drop, half twist, back drop. From a back drop, hold A or D as the bed throws you up.

tricks.name: Front drop
tricks.how: Land flat on your front. Tap W briefly during the push, a quarter turn forward, and stay straight.

tricks.name: Tuck jump
tricks.how: Knees to chest at the top of a straight bounce. Bounce at least 0.8 m and hold J in the air.

tricks.name: Pike jump
tricks.how: Legs straight out in front at the top. Tap K at the top and let go before you land; holding it lands a seat drop.

tricks.name: Half twist
tricks.how: A half turn about your long axis, landing facing the other way. Hold A or D through the push, no flip key.

tricks.name: Full twist jump
tricks.how: A whole turn about your long axis. Hold A or D through the whole push.

tricks.name: Back tuck
tricks.how: A backward somersault with knees to chest. Bounce to about 3 m, hold S while the bed throws you up, hold J in the air, and let go of J at three quarters of the turn so you slow down and land on your feet.

tricks.name: Back pike
tricks.how: A back somersault with straight legs folded at the hips: as the back tuck, with K in place of J. A pike turns slower than a tuck.

tricks.name: Back layout
tricks.how: A back somersault with the body straight. No tuck to speed you up, so bounce higher and hold S longer.

tricks.name: Back half
tricks.how: A back somersault with a half twist. Hold S and A or D together through the push.

tricks.name: Back full
tricks.how: A back somersault with a full twist. Hold S and A or D together through the push and stay straight: twisting is fastest with the body long.

tricks.name: Double full
tricks.how: A back somersault with two full twists. Get high, hold S and a twist key through the whole contact, stay straight.

tricks.name: Front tuck
tricks.how: A forward somersault with knees to chest. Hold W while the bed throws you up, tuck with J, open out before you land.

tricks.name: Front pike
tricks.how: A front somersault folded at the hips: W, then K in the air.

tricks.name: Front layout
tricks.how: A front somersault with the body straight. Bounce high and hold W for longer.

tricks.name: Barani
tricks.how: A front somersault with a half twist, landing facing back the way you came. Hold W and A or D through the push.

tricks.name: Rudy
tricks.how: A front somersault with one and a half twists. Hold W and a twist key through the push and stay straight.

tricks.name: Randy
tricks.how: A front somersault with two and a half twists. Very high, W and a twist key held through the whole contact.

tricks.name: Back tuck to seat
tricks.how: A back tuck that lands in a seat drop: let go of J early and hold K as you come down.

tricks.name: Double back
tricks.how: Two back somersaults in one flight. Bounce to 5 m or more, hold S through the whole contact, and tuck tight with J.

tricks.name: Double back pike
tricks.how: A double back folded at the hips: S through the contact, K in the air.

tricks.name: Double back layout
tricks.how: A double back with the body straight: the highest bounce you can make, S held all the way.

tricks.name: Full-in
tricks.how: A double back with a full twist. Hold S and a twist key through the push; the twist comes in the first somersault.

tricks.name: Double front
tricks.how: Two front somersaults in one flight. Very high, W through the contact, tight tuck.

tricks.name: Ball-out barani
tricks.how: A double front with a half twist. Very high, W and a twist key through the contact.

tricks.name: Triple back
tricks.how: Three back somersaults. The bed's whole height, S through the whole contact, the tightest tuck.

tricks.name: Triple front
tricks.how: Three front somersaults. The bed's whole height, W through the whole contact, the tightest tuck.
